options.name: Anger
options.benefit: Phantoms with this emotional focus are filled with seething anger from events in their past lives.

options.name: Dedication
options.benefit: Either through a sense of love or the desire to finish some unfinished task, a phantom with this emotional focus has an undying devotion to something or someone in the world.

options.name: Despair
options.benefit: Some creatures die in such horrific ways, or live such pointless and senseless lives, that despair grips their very beings.

options.name: Desperation
options.benefit: A phantom with this emotional focus died desperate and panicking—a victim of drowning, suffocation, or some other inexorable and traumatic death.

options.name: Fear
options.benefit: A phantom with this emotional focus suffered from overwhelming fear in life.

options.name: Greed
options.benefit: A phantom with this focus voraciously coveted gold, gems, and hedonistic possessions in life.

options.name: Hatred
options.benefit: Few things draw a spirit toward the Negative Material Plane like the emotion of hatred.

options.name: Jealousy
options.benefit: A phantom with this emotional focus is covetous of everything—its master, those who wish to do it harm, and any who do not pay attention to it.

options.name: Kindness
options.benefit: A phantom with this emotional focus was a being with a generous heart in life and continues to remain that way well after death.

options.name: Lust
options.benefit: A phantom with this focus aches for the intoxicating pleasures it experienced during life.

options.name: Pride
options.benefit: No phantom is as arrogant as a pride phantom, which in life was an insufferable braggart and egotist.

options.name: Remorse
options.benefit: Spirits of creatures that died with heavy weights upon their consciences manifest with the remorse emotional focus.

options.name: Suffering
options.benefit: Phantoms with this focus stand on trembling legs, with hands quivering and tears constantly streaming from their eyes.

options.name: Whimsey
options.benefit: Phantoms with this emotional focus carry a simplistic, childlike wonder and are fond of games and playing tricks.

options.name: Zeal
options.benefit: A phantom with this emotional focus fixates on every task given as if it were the phantom’s last.
